¿Cómo se nombra un compuesto inorgánico?: How do you name an inorganic compound?
Hay tres nomenclaturas: sistemática (pre: There are three nomenclatures: systematic (prefixes), Stock (Roman numeral) and traditional. Fe₂O₃ is diiron trioxide, iron(III) oxide or ferric oxide; CO₂ is carbon dioxide.
Ca(OH)₂ es hidróxido de calcio, H₂SO₄ es: Ca(OH)₂ is calcium hydroxide, H₂SO₄ is sulfuric acid (dihydrogen tetraoxidosulfate) and NaCl is sodium chloride. The tool goes from formula to name and from name to formula.

Tres formas de nombrar un compuesto: Three ways to name a compound
Un mismo compuesto tiene varios nombres: The same compound has several valid names, depending on the nomenclature used. In the systematic one, numerical prefixes say how many atoms there are of each element: Fe₂O₃ is diiron trioxide. In the Stock one, the oxidation state of the element that can have several is written in parentheses, in Roman numerals: Fe₂O₃ is iron(III) oxide. In the traditional one, suffixes and prefixes are used: iron with +2 is “ferrous” and with +3 “ferric”, so Fe₂O₃ is ferric oxide.
Para los oxoácidos y sus sales la tradic: For oxoacids and their salts the traditional one is the most used (sulfuric acid, sodium sulfate), but IUPAC recommends the systematic one: disodium tetraoxidosulfate.

El grupo SO₄ lleva paréntesis porque se: The SO₄ group takes parentheses because it is repeated three times; if the subscript were 1 there are no parentheses or number.
Cuando un elemento forma dos oxoácidos,: When an element forms two oxoacids, the one with the lower oxidation state ends in -ous (its salts in -ite) and the one with the higher in -ic (salts in -ate): H₂SO₃ is sulfurous acid and its salts the sulfites; H₂SO₄ is sulfuric acid and its salts the sulfates. The halogens have four: hypo-…-ous (+1), -ous (+3), -ic (+5) and per-…-ic (+7), as in HClO, HClO₂, HClO₃ and HClO₄.
Si un ácido con varios hidrógenos solo c: If an acid with several hydrogens gives up only some, the anion keeps the rest and is named with “hydrogen” in front (and di-, tri- if there are several): NaHCO₃ is sodium hydrogencarbonate and Ca(H₂PO₄)₂ calcium bis(dihydrogenphosphate).
En los compuestos de coordinación solo s: Coordination compounds only admit one central metal, with the metals and ligands in the tool's table: it does not name complexes with several metals, bridging ligands or isomers (cis/trans, fac/mer).
